description: This script retrieves IP addresses of various Hono services deployed in Kubernetes by querying service load balancer ingress IPs, and outputs shell commands to set environment variables with these IP addresses. It is used for configuring network endpoints in a deployment environment.

methods.name: get_service_ip
methods.description: Retrieves the load balancer IP address of a specified Kubernetes service and outputs a command to export it as an environment variable.
